adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the calendarId is now chosen via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, there is an explicit legacy/else path for destinations without `destination.credentialId` (it iterates credentials by `destination.integration` and calls `createEvent(c, event)`), meaning `destinationCalendar` entries may legitimately lack `credentialId`. In that case, GoogleCalendarService’s `.find(cal.credentialId === credentialId)` will never match, so `selectedCalendar` becomes undefined and the event is inserted into `primary` instead of the intended `destination.externalId`/destination calendar.
